narrative.intro: JT4 recorded $376M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. JT4 received one award in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $376M. Obligations fell 5.6% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show a rise and fall pattern: FY21 $322M, FY22 $325M, FY23 $391M, FY24 $385M, FY25 $398M, and FY26 $376M. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). The single large award in FY2026 to date drives the vendor-level totals and the average award size. The year-over-year decline reflects the FY25 to FY26 change in obligations. This snapshot describes contract obligations, not full contract values where noted elsewhere on award listings, and does not include line-item or task-order detail for the reported award.

sections.heading: How has JT4's contracting trended year to year?
sections.body: JT4 obligations rose from FY21 $322M to FY23 $391M, then dipped to FY24 $385M and peaked at FY25 $398M before falling to FY26 $376M. JT4 obligations fell 5.6% year over year. JT4 received one award in FY2026 to date, which sets the current-year totals.
